mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, p.product_code, p.part_no, p.product_name, p.spec, p.material, p.surface_hard_min, p.surface_hard_max, p.surface_hard_unit, p.core_hard_min, p.core_hard_max, p.core_hard_unit, v.vendor_id, v.vendor_code, v.vendor_name FROM base_pattern t JOIN base_product p ON p.product_id = t.product_id JOIN base_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(pattern_code, 3) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM base_pattern WHERE pattern_code REGEXP '^PT[0-9]+$'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO base_pattern ( pattern_code, pattern_name, product_id, charge_weight_kg, q1_zone, q2_zone, q3_zone, q4_zone, q5_zone, quench_speed, cp, t1_zone, t2_zone, t3_zone, t4_zone, t5_zone, temper_speed, speed_unit, remark, use_yn, reg_user_name, upd_user_name ) VALUES ( #{patternCode}, #{patternName}, #{productId}, #{chargeWeightKg}, #{q1Zone}, #{q2Zone}, #{q3Zone}, #{q4Zone}, #{q5Zone}, #{quenchSpeed}, #{cp}, #{t1Zone}, #{t2Zone}, #{t3Zone}, #{t4Zone}, #{t5Zone}, #{temperSpeed}, #{speedUnit}, #{remark}, #{useYn}, #{regUserName}, #{regUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE base_pattern SET pattern_name = #{patternName}, product_id = #{productId}, charge_weight_kg = #{chargeWeightKg}, q1_zone = #{q1Zone}, q2_zone = #{q2Zone}, q3_zone = #{q3Zone}, q4_zone = #{q4Zone}, q5_zone = #{q5Zone}, quench_speed = #{quenchSpeed}, cp = #{cp}, t1_zone = #{t1Zone}, t2_zone = #{t2Zone}, t3_zone = #{t3Zone}, t4_zone = #{t4Zone}, t5_zone = #{t5Zone}, temper_speed = #{temperSpeed}, speed_unit = #{speedUnit}, remark = #{remark}, use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_user_name = #{updUserName} WHERE pattern_id = #{patternId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO base_pattern_hist (pattern_id, pattern_code, action, field_label, before_value, after_value, user_name) VALUES (#{patternId}, #{patternCode}, #{action}, #{fieldLabel}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{userName})
